# Fan control (`fan-control`)

Speed steps or a percentage, oscillation, direction and preset modes for a fan.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createFanControl` (types in `dist/web/home/climate-energy/fanControl.d.ts`): `.mh-fan-control`: a `__power` switch row whose fan icon spins (faster with the speed; it stands still underreduced motion), then `__field`s, each with a visible `__field-label`: `--speed` (step buttons for two to six speeds,else a slider), `--direction` (forward / reverse) and `--preset` (segmented up to four, else a select), and the`__oscillate` switch row. States `.is-on`, `.is-spinning`, `.is-disabled`.

```ts
export function createFanControl(options: FanControlOptions): FanControlHandle;

export interface FanControlOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the whole control (default "Fan"). */
  label?: string;
  on: boolean;
  /** Speed as a percentage (0–100); `null` when the fan doesn't report one. */
  percentage?: number | null;
  /**
   * How many speeds the fan has. Two to six become step buttons ("1", "2", "3"); more, or none given, a 0–100%
   * slider (stepping by one speed when a count is given).
   */
  speedCount?: number;
  /** Oscillation; `null` or omitted hides the switch. */
  oscillating?: boolean | null;
  /** Blade direction; `null` or omitted hides the choice. */
  direction?: FanDirection | null;
  preset?: string | null;
  /** Up to four become a segmented control, more a select. */
  presets?: readonly FanPreset[];
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<FanControlLabels>;
  onToggle?: (on: boolean) => void;
  /** The chosen speed as a percentage: at once for a step, on release for the slider. */
  onPercentage?: (percentage: number) => void;
  onOscillate?: (oscillating: boolean) => void;
  onDirection?: (direction: FanDirection) => void;
  onPreset?: (preset: string) => void;
}

export interface FanControlHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value. A dragged speed stays on screen until it is sent. */
  update(changes: Partial<FanControlOptions>): void;
  /** Sends a dragged speed that was never released. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface FanControlLabels {
  power: string;
  speed: string;
  oscillate: string;
  direction: string;
  forward: string;
  reverse: string;
  preset: string;
  on: string;
  off: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createFanControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const fan = createFanControl({
  label: 'Bedroom fan',
  on: true,
  percentage: 67,
  // Three speeds become step buttons.
  speedCount: 3,
  oscillating: true,
  onToggle: (on) => fan.update({ on }),
  onPercentage: (percentage) => fan.update({ percentage, on: percentage > 0 }),
  onOscillate: (oscillating) => fan.update({ oscillating }),
});

document.body.append(fan.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FanControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function FanControlExample() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(true);
  const [percentage, setPercentage] = useState(67);
  const [oscillating, setOscillating] = useState(true);
  return (
    <FanControl
      label="Bedroom fan"
      on={on}
      percentage={percentage}
      // Three speeds become step buttons.
      speedCount={3}
      oscillating={oscillating}
      onToggle={setOn}
      onPercentage={(value) => {
        setPercentage(value);
        setOn(value > 0);
      }}
      onOscillate={setOscillating}
    />
  );
}
```
